character.name: Skarrik Redbrim

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: Hurls a mote of fire at a creature or object within 120 feet.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: Creates a sound or an image of an object within 30 feet.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: A 15-foot cone of flames scorches creatures, Dexterity save for half.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: Invisible barrier grants +5 AC until start of your next turn.

traits: Gnome Cunning: advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic
Darkvision 60 ft: sees in dim light as bright, darkness as gray
Tiny Frame: can squeeze through openings large enough for a rat
Red Brim Omen: the hat can shed crimson light once per day
character.gear: Ashvein Quarterstaff · Cinderpage Spellbook · Crimson Toadstool Hat · Healing Potion · Bitterroot Biscuits · Hempen Rope · Tallow Candles · Flint Striker
character.story: Skarrik Redbrim was found in a drowned mill, one foot tall and wearing a red hat too large for his skull. The hat whispers when blood is spilled. Other gnomes bartered his shadow to a bog-witch for safe passage, leaving him with cinders in his veins and a spellbook stitched from moth wings. He follows lantern smoke through the fen, collecting teeth, embers, and secrets.

inventory.name: Ashvein Quarterstaff
inventory.lore: Cut from a gallows-tree in the sunless fen, its knots look like closed eyes.
inventory.description: A thin gnarled staff that taps like bone on stone.

inventory.name: Cinderpage Spellbook
inventory.lore: Bound in moth-wing leather and stitched with hair from a drowned bell-ringer.
inventory.description: A tiny wizard's book whose pages warm when spells are near.

inventory.name: Crimson Toadstool Hat
inventory.lore: The crimson felt was dyed in a kettle of foxglove and old embers; it hums when lies are spoken.
inventory.description: A too-large red hat with a brim like a mushroom cap.
inventory.effects: Once per day, sheds crimson light in a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes.

inventory.name: Healing Potion
inventory.lore: Bottled by a blind apothecary who traded names for drops of blood.
inventory.description: A ruby-red draught in a wax-sealed vial.

inventory.name: Bitterroot Biscuits
inventory.lore: Baked from bog barley and salt tears, they keep hunger quiet but dream-heavy.
inventory.description: Hard black biscuits wrapped in cloth.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope
inventory.lore: Braided from hempen stalks grown beside a tomb-road, strong enough to bind a grave-spirit's anchor.

inventory.name: Tallow Candles
inventory.lore: Rendered from fat of moths that circled a dead lighthouse.
inventory.description: Greasy candles that burn with a pale orange flame.

inventory.name: Flint Striker
inventory.lore: Struck from a black altar where no fire would stay lit.
inventory.description: A small flint and steel for kindling flame.
